description: rebaseWhen: rebase a branch only when it conflicts with main. With the default (auto) Renovate rebased its open branches within minutes of every push to main: 41 CI runs in 52 hours, each of about 20 jobs, which queued the owner's runs behind them (2026-11-23..25). Before merging one that is behind, tick its rebase box to test it on today's main.
updateNotScheduled: false keeps every push to an existing branch inside the weekly schedule as well, so a conflicted branch is rebuilt on Monday morning and not in the middle of the week.

prConcurrentLimit: at most 5 open pull requests (and branches); prHourlyLimit: at most 1 new pull request an hour. Neither closes an open pull request: Renovate only stops opening new ones, security updates excepted.

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for every minor and patch update.

Dart, Flutter and native build tool updates in a weekly pull request of their own: a change to pubspec.lock or to a native project starts the native release builds on the pull request (Android, Windows, iOS, which gate the merge: scripts/classify-changes.mjs, NATIVE), and the JavaScript updates no longer carry them (2026-11-25: the grouped pull request ran 22 jobs, 6 of them native builds).
packageRules.groupName: Dart and native minor and patch updates

packageRules.description: Every GitHub Actions update, majors included, in one weekly pull request: a change to .github/workflows/ci.yml runs every CI job (scripts/classify-changes.mjs, CHECK_ENGINE), so one run covers them all.

pnpm refuses a package published less than a day ago (its minimumReleaseAge default, 1440 minutes), so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` failed on every update proposed on its release day. Renovate waits as long.
The Playwright packages move together: the smoke tests run the browsers of one @playwright/test version.
TypeScript 7 (the native compiler) is not supported by typescript-eslint, and openapi-typescript uses its removed compiler API: approved by the owner once both support it.
Runtimes move once a quarter, on staging first (architecture §19.4).
The Flutter SDK pins test_api and intl, so test, build_runner (through test's analyzer range) and intl move with Flutter (packages/core_api/CLAUDE.md).
A pg-boss update may change its schema version, which the running server refuses: its own pull request, approved by the owner (apps/server/CLAUDE.md, Jobs and timers).
NestJS stays on 11.x until nestjs-zod supports NestJS 12 (apps/server/CLAUDE.md).
